86453640a803b3b22aad.en: Newtalk News In early February, more than 10,000 Chinese troops withdrew from Dachen Island with the assistance of the US 7th Fleet, after the Chinese army lost control of Dachen Island in early 1955. The "Jiang Zhongzheng Diary" records that Jiang Zhong was reviewing the Suez Canal crisis in his diary. After the Second Israeli-Arabian War (also known as the "Suez Canal Crisis") in 1957, Jiang Zhong was writing in his diary on February 22: "Ike (US President Eisenhower) recently pressured Israel to withdraw from the occupying forces in Gaza and Akbar Bay in Egypt, just as he pressured me to withdraw from the islands in the same manner and attitude at the beginning of the previous year. I withdrew from Dachang Chen and he violated the promise of co-operation funds and horses, and then forced me to give up the Golden Gate to deal with the British to appease the Russian Communist Party...", thinking that Eisenhower "broke the contract too much". The National Museum of History has successively digitized and opened the "Jiang Zhongzheng Diary" and "Jiang Jingguo Diary".

e5888b279a3ba11943fe.en: Newtalk News Four Loans is finally wowing the FSC! Recently, the FSC announced that in order to prevent investors from excessive leverage, the Joint Signature Center will establish an interbank credit inquiry mechanism for banks and brokers, which is expected to be officially launched at the end of October. In the future, after obtaining the customer's consent, the bank can grasp the customer's financing situation at the brokerage firm side. The brokerage firm can also inquire about the customer's borrowing situation at the bank side, making up for the supervision gap of the "half each" of the banking and securities systems in the past. Housing expert Li Tongrong described the policy in eight words: "It's not too late to be alert." He also suggested that the FSC should have a "three-view" policy: observe the flow of funds, observe the overall leverage, and observe the concentration of leverage. At the same time, we should pay attention to funds such as floods, excessive leverage to operate the stock market, and not pay attention to the chaos of four loans or multiple loans. Once the stock market collapses and the financial system breaks down, it will inevitably explode into disaster.
